shortDescription: Indonesia's foreign exchange reserves rose by $1.2 billion in August to $146.5 billion, the central bank said on Monday, a level it said was above international standards and adequate to support external resilience.The August level was the equivalent of 5.4 months of imports, Bank Indonesia said.
